items: Fixed a crash on Android 12 when a controller disconnected while the app was open
Fixed the LED Light Test freezing while dragging the color picker
Fixed the Full Test page freezing when a Bluetooth controller connects
Fixed sticks, D-pad and triggers not responding on some controllers (DualShock, DualSense) while the buttons still worked
New LED Light Test: set the light bar color, then run solid-color, hue sweep and breathing checks to spot dead spots, tint or flicker
Needs a DualShock 4 or DualSense over Bluetooth, Android 12+. Wired PS, Xbox and other pads now get a clear explanation instead of a color picker that does nothing
Polling rate no longer reads lower than it really is, and the rating thresholds were retuned to real Android measurements
Every measurement now gets a rating (Excellent / Good / Fair / Poor) plus a plain-language verdict, with a reference table showing where your gamepad lands
Deadzone, drift, roundness, trigger travel, polling rate and jitter all covered
The rating prompt now only appears after you have actually tested a controller, and stays quiet after a failed test
Smaller app size for a faster download and install
Under-the-hood optimizations for smoother, more stable performance
